task.description: Implement DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 per the validated (PASS) design artefacts in artifacts_in. DDL-01: new src/platform/ddl_validate.zig with ValidatePlatformDDL composing ddl_namespace.checkNamespace plus new lock-class and non-concurrent-index checks, first-failure-in-statement-order aggregation (AC5). MIG-04: resumeFanout() added to existing src/platform/migration_fanout.zig, querying platform_migrations_resume_idx for pending/failed tenants only. MIG-05: change seedPendingRow's SQL to ON CONFLICT (migration_id, tenant_id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE status != 'done', plus an isAlreadyDone() pre-check so done tenants never get a transaction opened. MIG-06: three HTTP routes in new src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig (POST run, GET status, POST resume) gated by Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN per the existing onboarding.zig/webhooks.zig convention, plus assertNoOutstandingMigrations boot-time gate in src/main.zig::runApiServer following startup_assertions.zig's exact shape (typed error, FATAL log line, std.process.exit(78)). Read both design docs in full before writing any code -- they specify exact function signatures, error taxonomies, and the 3 open-question interim resolutions CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already accepted (MIG-05 AC5 = process discipline only, no runtime code; MIG-06 AC2 = caller-supplied known_migration_ids parameter; MIG-06 role = Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 is implemented (MIG-05 AC5 satisfied by the accepted process-discipline reading, not runtime code)
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool
Real unit + integration tests written and passing for all new code, with own addTest/build.zig wiring (verified real by deliberate-break test)

result.summary: Implemented DDL-01 (src/platform/ddl_validate.zig: pure ValidatePlatformDDL composing ddl_namespace.checkNamespace with new lock-class and non-concurrent-index checks, first-failure-in-statement-order aggregation, no allocator/I/O/clock/env), MIG-04 (resumeFanout() in src/platform/migration_fanout.zig querying platform_migrations_resume_idx for pending/failed tenants, reusing applyToTenant's MIG-02 transaction protocol), MIG-05 (seedPendingRow's SQL changed to ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... WHERE status != 'done', plus isAlreadyDone() pre-check in the fanout loop so done tenants never get a transaction opened; MIG-05 AC5 satisfied by the accepted process-discipline reading per the design doc's Open Questions #1, no runtime content-hash mechanism added), and MIG-06 (three route handlers in new src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig -- handleRunMigration/handleMigrationStatus/handleResumeMigration -- gated by Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN following the exact onboarding.zig/webhooks.zig convention, registered under /api/v1/admin/migrations/* in src/main.zig; new src/operations/pending_migration_gate.zig::assertNoOutstandingMigrations boot-time gate wired into runApiServer immediately after assertDatabaseConfiguration, following startup_assertions.zig's exact shape: typed PendingMigrationError set, FATAL log line via obs_logger.log, std.process.exit(78)). handleRunMigration takes a caller-supplied known_migration_ids parameter per the accepted interim design for AC2's unknown-migration 404 check. Wrote real unit tests for ddl_validate.zig (20 tests, pure, zero DB) and real integration tests against PostgreSQL for MIG-04/05 (tests/integration/migration_resume_test.zig, 9 tests) and MIG-06 (tests/integration/platform_migrations_admin_test.zig, 6 tests), all wired into build.zig with dedicated addTest roots and their own zig build test-* steps (test-ddl-validate, test-integration-mig04-mig05, test-integration-mig06). Verified all three new/extended test targets are genuinely wired by deliberately breaking one assertion in each, confirming the build went red (exit 1), then reverting. All gates ran green: zig build (exit 0), zig build migrate (exit 0, no pending migrations), zig build check (exit 0, scoped fmt clean after zig fmt on 9 changed files), python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR), zig build test (93/93 steps succeeded, 1041/1105 tests passed, 64 pre-existing unrelated skips, exit 0), and the new targeted steps run together with the full unit suite (102/102 steps, exit 0). No mocks/stubs/fakes anywhere; every integration test connects to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL through a real bpm.pool.Pool exactly as production code does. Two genuine memory leaks found and fixed during self-review (unfree'd migration_id/run_id/counts_suffix allocations in platform_migrations.zig, caught by testing.allocator under the new integration tests) -- not present in the final committed code.
result.next_action: Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (WF-02 Step 2c) -- MIG-06 adds new tenant-facing admin routes and a new boot-time DB-touching gate
